title: Mischievous Mermaid
meta_description: Find the perfect 30A, FL vacation rental at ‘Mischievous Mermaid’ a Luxury 7 Bedroom & 8.5 Bathroom vacation rental. Ideal for 28 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Elevator & Golf Cart for your enjoyment.
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: • 7 Bedrooms & 8.5 Half Baths • Sleeps 28 • SQFT: 6,080 • 6 Seater Golf Cart & 6 Adult Bikes Included • 3 Stories + Rooftop Terrace • Elevator • Gulf Views & Easy Beach Access • Heated Private Pool & Spa (Pool heating available Oct 1-May 1 for $40 per day) • Complimentary beach setups include 2 chairs and 1 umbrella - Service provided Mar 1-Oct 31 • Summer Kitchen/Grill & Outdoor Dining • Game Room with Pinball, Shuffleboard & PS5 • Parking for 5 Cars ‘Mischievous Mermaid’ is a luxurious 7-bedroom, 8.5-bathroom retreat nestled in the picturesque Seagrove Beach community, offering an unforgettable experience for up to 28 guests. Spanning over 6,000 square feet, this stunning home is designed for relaxation and entertainment, boasting a private pool and sitting spa, a lively game room with pinball machines, and an expansive rooftop terrace with breathtaking Gulf views. With the nearest beach access just a quick 1-minute stroll to the end of the street near Scenic 30A, you'll find everything you need for a perfect 30A beach getaway. As you step inside this gorgeous 3-story home, you'll be welcomed into a coastal haven of style and comfort. The second floor serves as the heart of the home, where a professionally designed great room with gleaming hardwood floors and a serene, natural color palette—enhanced by soft accents of Gulf hues —creates an inviting atmosphere. The primary living area is a perfect space for gatherings, with plush, cozy seating centered around a 55" TV for entertainment. An adjacent sitting area provides additional seating for four, offering even more space to relax and socialize. Under a modern chandelier, the elegant dining area features a combination of chair and bench seating, ideal for enjoying memorable meals with loved ones. The expansive kitchen island, complete with a built-in microwave and sink, doubles as an 8-seat breakfast bar for casual dining. The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, featuring sleek white cabinetry, premium appliances, and ample counter space for preparing delicious feasts. On this level, you'll find two thoughtfully designed guest bedrooms: one with a king bed and the other with two queen-over-queen beds, both with private balcony access for enjoying the fresh coastal breeze. Take the in-home elevator or stairs to the top floor, where a cozy living area with a TV welcomes you to unwind. Here, you'll discover four dreamy bedrooms, each designed with ultimate comfort in mind. The first guest bedroom offers a king bed, while a common area serves as a playful bunk haven featuring two Queen-over-Queen beds. A second guest bedroom also has a king bed, and the primary bedroom is a luxurious escape, with its king-sized bed, private en-suite bathroom, and access to the crown jewel of the home—the roof top terrace. This expansive outdoor space boasts spectacular views of the Gulf, providing the perfect backdrop for morning coffee or evening cocktails as you take in the stunning surroundings. The first floor of ‘Mischievous Mermaid’ is an entertainment paradise. The spacious living area is outfitted with a 55" TV and ample seating, creating a cozy spot for family movie nights or casual hangouts. The adjacent game room is sure to delight guests of all ages, featuring two vintage-style pinball machines and a shuffleboard table for friendly competition. For added convenience, there's also a laundry room on this level. Down the hallway, you'll find two additional guest suites, each with a king bed and ensuite bathroom, offering a peaceful retreat after a day of fun in the sun. Step outside to the private pool area, where an outdoor kitchen with a gas grill and an alfresco dining table awaits for effortless outdoor meals. A TV adds extra entertainment for poolside gatherings, while the sparkling pool and relaxing sitting spa are surrounded by lounge chairs, making it the perfect oasis for sunbathing or unwinding after a day at the beach. With on-site parking for five vehicles and six adult bikes included, plus a 6-seater golf cart, it's easy to explore the vibrant Seagrove Beach area and all the nearby attractions, such as iconic Seaside and adventurous Grayton Beach. ‘Mischievous Mermaid’ is the ultimate destination for families or groups seeking a luxurious beach vacation, with its abundant amenities and prime location just steps from the beach.
